chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to a group of people:
"You must surely attend the mosque, or I will burn down your houses over you."

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque; the place of communal worship
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How strongly does this hadith emphasize attending the mosque for congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly urges attendance at the mosque for congregational salat (prayer). Its forceful wording shows the great importance of communal worship and warns against neglecting it without excuse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1092 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said to a group of people:
"You must attend the mosque, or I will burn down your houses."
